title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals and policies drive the adoption and sustained use of face masks across a population, including social influence, enforcement, availability, and cost factors.

interactions.name: social_contact
interactions.description: People interact at locations according to schedules and contact rates; interactions can transmit norms, information, and (if modeled) infection risk.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals update mask beliefs and adoption based on neighbors’ behaviors and household norms.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask policies; non-compliance may trigger warnings or fines affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: public_campaign_exposure
interactions.description: Authority and information sources broadcast messages that alter risk perception, perceived benefits, and trust.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks subject to price and inventory constraints.

interactions.name: supply_restock
interactions.description: Retailers restock inventory based on schedules or stochastic processes.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of population wearing masks consistently at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption level reached during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days until at least half the population adopts consistent mask use.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_post_mandate
metrics.description: Average adoption level in the period after mandates end.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of interactions in mandate settings where masks are worn.

metrics.name: equity_gap_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between low- and high-income groups.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days retailers experience stockouts.

metrics.name: average_contacts_masked
metrics.description: Average number of daily contacts where both parties are masked.
